# Ryan Harricharan

> Product designer who designs and builds apps, from first sketch to launch. Awwwards Young Jury member, previously a Product Designer at A Small Studio®. Available for work.

## Services
- Product design for web and iPhone apps, from flows to dev-ready screens
- Designing AI products: agents, assistants and AI features people can trust
- Design systems
- Design engineering: building and shipping the front end

## Case studies
- [STIM](https://rharricharan.com/smartstop): How Ryan designed STIM, Smartstop’s AI traffic platform: twelve tools down to one, 22% more traffic efficiency, and five cities signed.
- [Shift AI](https://rharricharan.com/shift): Designing Shift, Inclusive Health’s AI debrief coach for physicians: onboarding, Morning Rounds, chats and insights, from MVP through v2.
- [uLogic](https://rharricharan.com/ulogic): Designing uLogic’s renewal workspace and design system for data center operators, shipped in early 2026 and saving teams 10 hours a week.
- [Rays](https://rharricharan.com/rays): Rays, an iPhone app that helps people tan for their skin type without burning. A product design case study by Ryan Harricharan.
- [Halftone](https://rharricharan.com/halftone): Halftone’s website, merch for the biggest names in music and sport: site traffic up 80% and clients grown from 3 to 15 in two years.
- [LeadHack](https://rharricharan.com/leadhack): LeadHack’s website: lead generation for agencies, told in one scroll, and part of the pitch for its $3M+ seed round.
- [Our Next Energy](https://rharricharan.com/one): Our Next Energy’s website, CMS, launches and signage: online conversions up 15%, and three launches behind $20M in new investment.
- [Cinnamon](https://rharricharan.com/cinnamon): Cinnamon’s website: business phone lines on a new 5G network, a simpler and more affordable alternative to the big carriers.
- [GoSTR](https://rharricharan.com/gostr): GoSTR Marketing’s website: conversions up 65% and monthly recurring revenue up 77% in the year after the new site launched.
- [Avé](https://rharricharan.com/ave): Art direction, photography and website for Avé, a scrub cap brand for healthcare workers: $100K in year-one sales and two hospital partnerships.
